firstPlayerRule: The last player to have missed a train becomes the Start Player.
clarifications: That player receives the Start Player marker, the black die, and white dice equal to the player count plus one.
The Start Player rolls all dice and takes the first action.
internalEvidence: The Stronghold Games English booklet states the missed-train criterion in setup step 9 on page 2 and the first regular action on page 3.
